set.input.throttleStyle.help: Stick in the centre (camera drone): the throttle stick springs to the centre: centre holds the height, up climbs, down descends. Let go and the drone stops and hovers. The motors start when you move a stick. From zero (FPV): as FPV pilots fly: the motors start (this is called arming) only with the throttle stick all the way down, and the stick sets the motors' power. Automatic chooses by where your stick rests. Saved for each controller; J switches it. Touch and the keyboard always fly without arming.
keys.throttle.style: Throttle stick: in the centre (camera drone) or from zero (FPV)
throttle.afterLanding: Throttle stick: {style} after landing (the motors are running now)
throttle.radioOnly: This is for a radio or a gamepad. Touch and the keyboard already fly without arming (the motors start by themselves).
throttle.about.centred: The throttle stick springs to the centre: centre holds the height, up climbs, down descends. Let go and the drone stops and hovers. The motors start when you move a stick.
throttle.about.zero: As FPV pilots fly: the motors start (this is called arming) only with the throttle stick all the way down, and the stick sets the motors' power.
throttle.why.centre: Chosen automatically: your throttle stick rests in the centre.
throttle.why.bottom: Chosen automatically: your throttle stick rests at the bottom.
throttle.why.parked: Chosen automatically: your throttle stick rests between the bottom and the centre.
throttle.why.table: Chosen automatically: this controller's throttle stick springs back to the centre.
throttle.offer.rest: Your throttle stick is resting in the centre, so the motors cannot start the FPV way.
throttle.offer.fpv: To fly like FPV, lower the throttle stick all the way down, then press your controller's start/stop button or flip its arm switch: that starts the motors (this is called arming).
throttle.offer.button: Fly with the stick in the centre
throttle.offer.keys: Or press {src} on your controller, or J on the keyboard.
throttle.offer.keysOnly: Or press J on the keyboard.
throttle.acro: Acro: the throttle stick sets the motors' power directly, the centre is half power. The height is held only in angle and horizon.
throttle.card.centred: Stick in the centre (camera drone): no arming needed. Push the throttle stick up to climb, down to descend, let go to hover. The motors start when you move a stick.
throttle.card.acro: Acro: lower the throttle stick all the way down to start the motors; then it sets their power directly (the centre is half power).
